description: Fetch one post by url or shortcode: caption, owner, media type, like/comment counts, timestamp, media urls. Works for /p/, /reel/, /tv/. Like ig_fetch_posts plus owner and full-size media.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

shortcode.description: Post shortcode on its own, e.g. ABC123. Give this or url.

url.description: Post permalink, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/ABC123/. Give this or shortcode.

name: ig_fetch_post
title: Instagram fetch post
